description: We are seeking a dedicated Assistant Director of Nursing to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This leadership role offers a vital opportunity to contribute to high-quality patient care and support the nursing team in a dynamic environment. If you are passionate about making a difference in the lives of residents and thrive in a collaborative setting, we encourage you to apply.This full-time position offers a competitive salary ranging from $60,000 to $75,000 per year, based on experience. You will play a key role in overseeing daily nursing operations, ensuring compliance with healthcare regulations, and fostering a supportive atmosphere for both staff and residents. We are looking for a leader who can inspire excellence and maintain the highest standards of care.We are actively seeking candidates with an RN background to fill this urgent need. Join a team committed to compassionate care and professional growth. Apply today to learn more about this exciting opportunity.
requirements: Previous leadership or supervisory experience in nursing
Experience within a skilled nursing or long-term care facility
Strong understanding of state and federal healthcare regulations
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $60,000 to $75,000 annually, based on experience.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier skilled nursing facility in Olathe, KS. This pivotal leadership role offers a competitive salary range of $75,000 - $85,000 per year, providing an excellent opportunity for a Registered Nurse ready to advance their career.

As an ADON, you will play a crucial role in supporting the Director of Nursing, overseeing daily clinical operations, and ensuring the highest standards of patient care. You will contribute to staff development, maintain regulatory compliance, and foster a positive and supportive environment for both residents and staff. This position is ideal for a compassionate leader committed to making a significant impact on the lives of others.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Kansas
Previous experience in a supervisory or leadership role within a skilled nursing or long-term care setting
Strong clinical assessment and critical thinking skills
Knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations

description: We are urgently seeking dedicated and compassionate Licensed Practical Nurses (LPNs) for PRN/Part-time opportunities in Dacula, GA. This is an excellent chance to join a dynamic team within a premier home health agency, offering flexible scheduling and competitive per-case compensation. If you are an LPN looking for impactful work with the autonomy of a 1099 contractor, we encourage you to apply.This role offers a highly attractive compensation model, paying $90-$120 per case, with the expectation of managing 3 or more cases per week. As a 1099 contractor, you'll have the flexibility to manage your schedule while providing essential care to patients in their homes. We are looking for professionals who are ready to make an immediate impact and contribute to patient well-being.
requirements: Active LPN license in the state of Georgia
Proven experience as an LPN, preferably in a home health or similar setting
Ability to manage a caseload of 3+ cases per week
Strong clinical assessment and documentation skills
Reliable transportation and ability to travel to patient homes
